# ReLTER

[ReLTER](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER) is an R package that provides
access to [DEIMS-SDR](https://deims.org/), allowing to interact with
software implemented by eLTER Research Infrastructure (RI) and improving
the data/information shared among the Long Term Ecological Research
(LTER) network. This package was conceived within eLTER H2020 project
and will help advance the development of European Long-Term Ecosystem
Research Infrastructures ([eLTER RI](https://elter-ri.eu)).

The [ReLTER](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER) package functions in
particular allows to:

- retrieve the information about entities (e.g. sites, datasets, and
  activities) shared by [DEIMS-SDR](https://deims.org/) (see e.g.
  [get_site_info
  function](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/get_site_info.html));

- elaborate the information of single site or merge info from national
  network sites or entire International LTER (ILTER) in order to provide
  maps, figures, graphs etc (see e.g.
  [get_network_sites](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/get_network_sites.html),
  [produce_site_map](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/produce_site_map.html)
  or
  [produce_site_observedProperties_pie](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/produce_site_observedProperties_pie.html)
  functions);

- interact with the
  [ODSEurope](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/maps.opendatascience.eu)
  managed by members of the
  [Geo-harmonizer](https://opendatascience.eu/geoharmonizer-project/)
  project starting with the dataset shared by
  [DEIMS-SDR](https://deims.org/) (see e.g.
  [get_site_ODS](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/get_site_ODS.html)
  function);

- improve the quality of the dataset (see e.g.
  [get_id_worms](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/get_id_worms.html)).

Functions currently implemented are derived from the discussion of the
needs declared by eLTER users community.

The [ReLTER](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER) package will follow the
progress of eLTER-RI infrastructure and evolve with improvements and
development of new tools.

Visit the [ReLTER](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER) website at
[docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/) for
further documentation, examples, and installation of the package.

The manual of [ReLTER](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER) package could
be found [here](https://ropensci.r-universe.dev/manual/ReLTER.pdf).

## ⏬ Installation

You can install the main version of
[ReLTER](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER) from
[GitHub](https://github.com/ropensci/ReLTER) with:

``` R
install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("ropensci/ReLTER")
library(ReLTER)
```

If you want to install different package branch (e.g. ‘dev’) can you use
this command:

``` R
devtools::install_github('https://github.com/ropensci/ReLTER', ref = 'dev')
```

The [ReLTER](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER) package is part of the
[R-universe](https://r-universe.dev/) community and it can be installed
also use this command:

``` R
utils::install.packages("ReLTER", repos = "https://ropensci.r-universe.dev")
```

Alternatively {`ReLTER`} can be used [in a Docker
container](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/articles/rocker_ReLTER.md).

If you wish to help develop this package, please follow the
[contributing
guidelines](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/CONTRIBUTING.md).

# Package index

## All functions

- [`get_site_info()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/get_site_info.md)
  **\[stable\]** : Obtain details about an eLTER site.

- [`get_activity_info()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/get_activity_info.md)
  **\[stable\]** : Obtain the information about of an eLTER activity.

- [`get_dataset_info()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/get_dataset_info.md)
  **\[deprecated\]** : Obtain the information about of an eLTER dataset.

- [`get_location_info()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/get_location_info.md)
  **\[stable\]** : Obtain the information about of an eLTER location.

- [`get_sensor_info()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/get_sensor_info.md)
  **\[deprecated\]** : Obtain the information about of an eLTER sensor.

- [`get_site_EcoDataCube()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/get_site_EcoDataCube.md)
  **\[stable\]** :

  Acquire various raster layers from [EcoDataCube
  EU](https://ecodatacube.eu/) and crop to an eLTER site boundary.

- [`EDC_construct_full_url()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/EDC_construct_full_url.md)
  **\[stable\]** : Construct full url for download

- [`get_site_speciesOccurrences()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/get_site_speciesOccurrences.md)
  **\[stable\]** : Retrieve species occurrences within an eLTER site
  boundary

- [`get_sites_interactive()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/get_sites_interactive.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Select sites by choosing a 3d bounding box
  through an interactive GUI.

- [`get_sites_within_3d_bounding_box()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/get_sites_within_3d_bounding_box.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : select sites within a 3d bounding box

- [`get_sites_within_radius()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/get_sites_within_radius.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Get all sites within a given distance of a
  point location

- [`get_network_sites()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/get_network_sites.md)
  **\[stable\]** : Retrieve a list of sites in an eLTER Network.

- [`get_zenodo_data()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/get_zenodo_data.md)
  **\[deprecated\]** : Obtain the data from a dataset deposited in
  Zenodo record.

- [`get_deims_API_version()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/get_deims_API_version.md)
  **\[stable\]** : Get version of DEIMS-SDR API

- [`get_deims_base_url()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/get_deims_base_url.md)
  **\[stable\]** : Get DEIMS-SDR base URL

- [`set_deims_base_url()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/set_deims_base_url.md)
  **\[stable\]** : Set DEIMS-SDR API base URL

- [`package_settings`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/package_settings.md)
  **\[stable\]** : Package settings that can be changed by the user

- [`produce_network_points_map()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/produce_network_points_map.md)
  **\[stable\]** : Provide a map (image) of sites in an eLTER Network.

- [`produce_site_map()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/produce_site_map.md)
  **\[stable\]** : Provide a map object of a sites LTER.

- [`produce_site_qrcode()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/produce_site_qrcode.md)
  **\[stable\]** : Obtain the QRCode of any DEIMS-SDR entities.

- [`produce_site_observedProperties_pie()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/produce_site_observedProperties_pie.md)
  **\[stable\]** : Produce a pie chart of the observed properties
  collected in a site LTER.

- [`produce_site_observedProperties_waffle()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/produce_site_observedProperties_waffle.md)
  **\[stable\]** : Produce a waffle chart of the observed properties
  collected in an eLTER site

- [`taxon_id_pesi()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/taxon_id_pesi.md)
  **\[stable\]** :

  Provide a taxon ID [LSID](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/LSID) to a
  taxon list.

- [`taxon_id_worms()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/taxon_id_worms.md)
  **\[stable\]** :

  Enrich and certify a list of species names by comparing with
  [WoRMS](https://www.marinespecies.org).

- [`map_occ_gbif2elter()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/map_occ_gbif2elter.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Harmonize outputs of get_site_speciesOccurrence
  and map them into eLTER reporting format

- [`map_occ_inat2elter()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/map_occ_inat2elter.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Harmonize outputs of get_site_speciesOccurrence
  and map them into eLTER reporting format

- [`map_occ_obis2elter()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/map_occ_obis2elter.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Harmonize outputs of get_site_speciesOccurrence
  and map them into eLTER reporting format

- [`save_occ_eLTER_reporting_Archive()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/save_occ_eLTER_reporting_Archive.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Creates an archive with files following the
  eLTER reportingFormat

- [`eLTER_data_reporting_format`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/eLTER_data_reporting_format.md)
  **\[experimental\]** :

  eLTER Data Reporting Format
  ([DRF](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.6373410))

- [`reporting_produce_data_object_v1.3()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/reporting_produce_data_object_v1.3.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Compose an eLTER Data Reporting Format object

- [`reporting_produce_data_object_v2.0()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/reporting_produce_data_object_v2.0.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Compose an eLTER Data Reporting Format object

- [`reporting_save_archive()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ReLTER/reference/reporting_save_archive.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Creates an archive with files following the
  eLTER reportingFormat
